Noble Compass
Turn the mod on or off. Off hides the compass and the encyclopedia button; the noble you picked is kept.
Track any hero, not only nobles
Off: the compass button only shows on the encyclopedia pages of lords and ladies. On: it shows for every living hero, such as companions, wanderers and notables.
Only heroes you have met

Your scouts can only follow someone you have met in person. The compass button still shows for others, but tells you that you haven't met them yet, and an arrow already following someone you haven't met stays hidden.
Range (Scouting)
Range with 0 Scouting

How close, in map distance, the noble must be for the compass to appear when your party's scout has no Scouting skill. For scale, a party usually covers about 4 to 6 map distance per hour. Turn on Debug messages to see the current distance and range.
Extra range per Scouting point
Range added for every point of Scouting your party's scout has (or your own, if no scout is assigned). With the defaults: 20 at 0 Scouting, 50 at 100, 110 at 300.
Unlimited range
Show the compass at any distance and ignore Scouting.
Compass size
Width of the circle the arrow travels around your party, in UI units (it follows the game's UI scale). Smaller keeps the arrow closer to your party.
Show who you're looking for
Show "Looking for" and the noble's name under your party while the arrow is shown.
Arrow color
Color of the arrow as #RRGGBB (or #RRGGBBAA), used when it isn't colored by distance.
Color the arrow by distance
Blend the arrow from the far color, at the edge of your scouting range, to the near color as you close in on the noble.
Near color
Arrow color when the noble is right next to you, as #RRGGBB. Only used when coloring by distance.
Far color

Arrow color when the noble is at the edge of your scouting range, as #RRGGBB. Only used when coloring by distance. In between, the colors blend around the color wheel (green to red passes through yellow).
Announce when the trail is found or lost
Show a message at the top of the screen when the noble comes within range and the compass appears, and when they move out of range again.
Debug messages
Every few seconds while tracking, show the distance to the noble, your scout's Scouting skill and the compass range in the chat log. Useful for tuning the range; turn it off for normal play.
